research_status: COMPLETE — all 26 episodes classified filler. Unlike every other show in this catalog, this isn't scattered padding around an otherwise-adapting story: the anime deliberately tells a different story from Rikdo Koshi's manga throughout, at the publisher's own request and with the creator's approval. animefillerlist.com independently confirms the same 100% figure. A genuine edge case, included here (unlike Yashahime/Devilman) because the manga did exist first and the divergence is fully documented, not because the classification is ambiguous.

citation_sources.description: animefillerlist.com's Excel Saga page, classifying all 26 episodes as filler (100%).
